messages:
ashley-support: Customer (acct: acct_0abc123) opened a ticket — they say an AWS Activate / Accelerator credit (grant id ACT-2026-9982) was promised but is not reflected on their Redwood billing page. They purchased via AWS Marketplace (order: 1234-aws-ord-9876). Customer says partner portal shows the grant as 'posted' but account balance is unchanged.
jess-billing: thanks. can you paste the marketplace order id + the customer's email used to sign up? also which region/tenant? quick check: sometimes accelerator grants land on partner ledger instead of direct credits.
ashley-support: order id 1234-aws-ord-9876, customer email: ops+zeta@example.com, tenant id: ten_5f2bd. Claim id from partner portal: ACT-2026-9982. Customer sent screenshot: https://redwood.internal/attachments/awspartners/act-9982-snap.png
maria-partners: likely an accelerator grant routed through Partnerships ledger. Those sometimes need manual mapping to the customer's tenant if they used a different billing email. can you confirm their signup email matches the marketplace purchase email? if not, we'll need the marketplace invoice PDF.
ashley-support: customer confirmed signup email is ops+zeta@example.com (same). they attached AWS invoice: https://s3.internal/reports/aws-invoice-1234.pdf
kyle-ops: checking sync logs now. there's a recurring marketplace sync job (marketplace-sync-v2) that posts credits into the ledger. i see a 502 from partner gateway for partner aws at 2026-02-12T03:12:07Z for order 1234-aws-ord-9876 — job retried but hit rate limit, might have failed to map claim to tenant. here's the log snippet:
```
[2026-02-12T03:12:07Z] marketplace-sync-v2 ERROR partner=aws order=1234-aws-ord-9876 status=502 body="Bad Gateway"
[2026-02-12T03:12:12Z] marketplace-sync-v2 WARN retry=1 order=1234-aws-ord-9876
[2026-02-12T03:12:45Z] marketplace-sync-v2 ERROR mapping=missing tenant=ten_5f2bd claim=ACT-2026-9982
```
kyle-ops: you can try a manual remap + re-run: /srv/bin/billing-admin remap-claim --claim ACT-2026-9982 --tenant ten_5f2bd && /srv/bin/billing-admin run-sync --partner aws --order 1234-aws-ord-9876
ashley-support: i'm going to ask billing to run the remap and trigger the job; looping in @jess-billing
jess-billing: on it — running remap now. pinging billing-bot to run a manual sync.
billing-bot: Manual sync requested by jess-billing. Re-running marketplace-sync-v2 for partner=aws order=1234-aws-ord-9876 ...
billing-bot: Manual sync completed. Credit applied: $30,000 (ACT-2026-9982) posted to tenant ten_5f2bd ledger at 2026-02-12T03:58:21Z. Reference txn id: txn_billing_7789
ashley-support: told customer to refresh billing UI and check invoices; asked them to confirm once they see the credit.
ashley-support: customer replied "i see the credit, thanks! ledger shows ACT-2026-9982 and new balance reflects grant." :tada:
jess-billing: great. i'll add a short note to the partner sync runbook: when gateway 502s happen, include automated retry with exponential backoff + explicit mapping check to avoid orphaned claims.
maria-partners: i'll notify AWS partner rep so they can watch for gateway flakiness on their side. also adding this case to the accelerator onboarding checklist.
ashley-support: closing the ticket after confirmation. tagging for follow-up postmortem with kyle and jess next week to tighten mapping alerts.
